invariants.rule: Task.id is computed once at construction (url + type + preferences hash) and never recomputed by copy; it keys processes, audit logs and notification ids.
Each submission gets a fresh UUID batch id; it keys the batch notification and the review entry. Compose keys use uiKey = id#batchId.
A new pick is pending until a non-empty verified file exists; only then confirmSelection deletes the old row+file. The parked old path lives in memory only.
GhostEngine.watch returns the terminal snapshot for its task; progressFlow is a UI mirror and must never decide an outcome.

NetworkPolicy.canStartDownloads is the only gate; enforced once in doYourWork plus one parked-action holder (PendingMetered) shared by the three hosts. Permit is a 5-minute window, not a consumed token. Fail-open.

Every queue state write goes through DownloaderV2Impl.applyTransition, which consults TaskTransitions.isLegal under one lock; an edge outside the table is refused and logged. Restore maps in-flight states to Canceled with a retry action (a killed process cannot resume yt-dlp), and auto-continue is deliberately not an edge.
One transferClaimed CAS in AppUpdateManager owns the APK transfer; UpdateDownloadService answers every start with startForeground and posts exactly one terminal notification.
Quick mode never carries cookie/session state: withoutCookies() clears the flag, and only plain URL tasks are built on that lane.
Batch songs do not post per-task notifications; one batch notification carries progress and is replaced by the review entry.

risks.summary: Cancelling a pending swap never clears match.pending (cancelImpl does not touch match; abandonSwappedFile only runs on download failure), so the review row stays 'Replacing…' with radios disabled until a successful retry.
pendingSwapCleanup is in-memory; after process death a successful retry promotes the new pick but cannot delete the replaced file or its history row, leaving an orphan and a duplicate history row.
Task.copy(preferences=...) keeps the old id while preferences change, so id no longer equals makeId(...). Harmless today but any new code that recomputes ids from fields will disagree.

Open regression: _LONG_FORM_PART_RE treats a slash-numbered title as a part marker, so '11/22/63 | Full Audiobook' strips to '/63', scores below the long-form floor, and fails with 'No confident YouTube match' (Error, no picker). Verified 2026-11-12; needs a ranker test case.
